decisions.rationale: ROOT agrees that copying an unverified timestamp from initial status and comparing terminal status back to it does not bind either artifact to the registered process. The repository already has exact process-incarnation and OS process-snapshot primitives, so an identity-before/snapshot/identity-after observation can derive the lane controller's canonical status timestamp without new infrastructure. Requiring initial and terminal equality to that OS-derived binding and adding mismatch tests is a localized fix whose provenance benefit clearly exceeds its implementation and regression cost.
decisions.smallest_fix: Derive the expected controller status PID/UTC from a complete OS process snapshot bracketed by equal exact process-incarnation observations, require initial and terminal status to match it, and exactly terminate/reap on an initial mismatch.
